entries.title: Migration — Survey Migration
entries.desc: Copy surveys between Qualtrics instances. Select multiple surveys, migrate in one click, and download a full ID mapping report.

entries.title: Migration — Library Message Migration
entries.desc: Migrate library messages across instances. Auto-detects available libraries — no manual ID entry needed. Filter by category before migrating.

entries.title: Data Preparation Tools
entries.desc: Four native tools: CSV Comparator (with Qualtrics SDS validation), CSV Data Prep (clean, transform, split), CSV Merger, and Excel Merger — all client-side, no file uploads.

entries.title: Ticketing — Get Ticket Statuses
entries.desc: Retrieve all configured ticket statuses for your brand. Requires Closed Loop Follow Up subscription.

entries.title: Professional Result UI
entries.desc: Bulk operation results now render as structured cards with stats, per-row status, and a Download Report button.

entries.title: Help Panel
entries.desc: Slide-in help panel replaces the sidebar card — more space, collapsible sections, quick links to API docs and Pirai AI tools.

entries.title: Rate Limiting — Ticket Updates
entries.desc: Ticket update endpoints now batch at 45 requests with automatic 61-second pauses to stay within Qualtrics rate limits.

entries.title: Update Ticket & Ticket Additional Data
entries.desc: Bulk update ticket fields and custom data from CSV.

entries.title: Upload Automation File
entries.desc: Upload files to Qualtrics automation workflows up to 500MB.

entries.title: Insert Embedded Data Fields
entries.desc: Add embedded data fields to surveys in bulk from CSV.

entries.title: Pirai AI Design System
entries.desc: Full UI refresh — white surfaces, blue-to-purple gradient accent, Inter font.

entries.title: Get Survey

entries.title: Bulk Update Responses
entries.desc: Update embedded data across multiple responses from CSV.
